title: Debit-card purchases contract in absolute terms

title: Credit cards grow but lose share
estimate: Credit +27.1% a year [95% CI +22.0%, +32.4%]; P2M minus credit +0.222 log points a year [95% CI +0.033, +0.411]
consistency: Credit growth positive in 39 of 39 months; P2M faster in 38 of 39
test: Two parts: mean Δ12 ln(credit) > 0, and mean [Δ12 ln(P2M) − Δ12 ln(credit)] > 0. Mean 12-month log change, Newey-West (12-lag) standard errors, 39 matched months Jan 2023–Mar 2026.
data: RBI Payment System Indicators: domestic debit/credit card purchases; NPCI UPI ecosystem statistics: P2P/P2M

title: Ticket sorting: UPI takes the small payments

consistency: Debit ticket up in 39 of 39 months; P2M ticket down in 38 of 39
test: Two parts: mean Δ12 ln(real debit ticket) > 0 and mean Δ12 ln(real P2M ticket) < 0. Mean 12-month log change, Newey-West (12-lag) standard errors, 39 matched months Jan 2023–Mar 2026. Real = March 2026 rupees (MoSPI CPI).

title: IMPS turns from share loss to absolute contraction
estimate: sup-F = 62.2 at 2024-07; trend +15.4% a year before, -12.8% after
consistency: Rolling 12-month IMPS volume peaked at 6.17 bn and is 4.94 bn in the latest 12 months
test: Quandt–Andrews sup-F for a break in level and slope of ln(IMPS volume), 2021-01–2026-03, month dummies, 15% trimming; 5% critical value ≈ 11.7. Residual autocorrelation inflates F, so treat as indicative.

title: A log-scale seasonal model forecasts debit volume best
estimate: Linear level trend 50.0%; Log-linear + month dummies 12.2%; Seasonal naive 25.8%; Seasonal naive × last-year growth 10.9%
consistency: Lowest MAPE: Seasonal naive × last-year growth
test: Train 2022-01–2025-03, forecast the next 12 months; compare mean absolute percentage error (MAPE). Damped Holt-Winters (MAPE ≈ 4%) is in planning/pilot_tests.py.
data: RBI Payment System Indicators: domestic debit/credit card purchases

title: Debit-card payments fall while cards remain in force
consistency: Cards rose in 39 of 39 matched months; payments/card fell in 39 of 39.
test: Mean 12-month log change in cards outstanding (> 0) and domestic debit-card payments per card (< 0), each with Newey-West (12-lag) standard errors over 39 matched months, Jan 2023–Mar 2026. Both 95% intervals must be on the predicted side of zero for full support.
data: RBI Payment System Indicators: Part I 4.2 domestic debit-card payments; Part III 1.2 debit cards outstanding (lakh), own-month release pages.

title: UPI QR codes grow faster than PoS terminals
estimate: UPI QR minus PoS terminal growth +0.220 log points a year [95% CI +0.099, +0.341]; card PoS payments/terminal -15.4% a year [95% CI -21.5%, -8.8%]
consistency: UPI QR grew faster in 37 of 39 matched months; card payments/terminal fell in 36 of 39.
test: Two parts: mean [Δ12 ln(UPI QR codes) − Δ12 ln(PoS terminals)] > 0, and mean Δ12 ln((debit + credit PoS purchase volume) / PoS terminals) < 0. Newey-West (12-lag) standard errors over 39 matched months, Jan 2023–Mar 2026. Both 95% intervals must be on the predicted side of zero for full support.
data: RBI Payment System Indicators: Part I 4.1/4.2 domestic credit- and debit-card PoS purchase volume; Part III UPI QR codes and PoS terminals (lakh), own-month release pages.
